COST: 170

All 11 elderly people are rescued, so there are no deferral penalties. The 170 minutes is driving time: 14 for the Kalika round trip, plus two 78-minute round trips to Trishuli farm (the car holds 4, so 7 people need two trips). Deferring anyone would cost 50 per elderly person, which is more than the driving saved by skipping a trip.
